feed.title: Buildocrat Rate Book - Nigeria construction price updates

entry.title: Price update 2026-10-06
entry.summary: Restored from artifact: the 5 Oct and 6 Oct refreshes (naira, diesel, petrol, LPG, Dangote and BUA cement, 9-inch block, four aluminium roofing lines, 2.5mm2 cable), which had been published but not saved to the repo. Follow-up check found no new dated Abuja evidence for the cement average, rebar, sharp sand or granite, and no dated source to upgrade LOW plumbing or long-reach excavator lines; no further price changes.

entry.title: Price update 2026-10-06
entry.summary: Weekly refresh: naira N1,328 -> N1,333/$ (CBN NFEM, 6 Oct; imported items follow); diesel N1,900 -> N1,870/L (Dangote gantry cut N1,850 -> N1,780, national pump avg N1,811); petrol Abuja N1,400 -> N1,385/L (NNPC N1,370, independents N1,400); 2.5mm2 cable 100m coil N85,000 -> N77,000 (Coleman retailer list, LOW -> MEDIUM); LPG N1,100/kg, 9-inch block N850 and aluminium roofing reconfirmed. Cement average, rebar, sand and granite unchanged (no fresh Abuja source). Also saves the 5 Oct refresh (Dangote/BUA cement), which had been published but not saved to the repo.

entry.title: Price update 2026-10-05
entry.summary: Weekly refresh: naira N1,331 -> N1,328/$ (CBN NFEM, 2 Oct; imported items follow); petrol N1,360 -> N1,400/L (Abuja pumps N1,370-1,450); Dangote cement N12,300 -> N12,500/bag and BUA N11,800 -> N12,200/bag (Abuja dealer checks, 21 Sep); 0.40mm roofing confirmed at N5,600/m2. Cement average, rebar, diesel, LPG, blocks, sand and granite unchanged (no new Abuja-dated evidence).

entry.title: Price update 2026-10-01
entry.summary: Added 207 construction equipment purchase prices (new and used): excavators, loaders, dozers, graders, rollers, pavers, asphalt and batching plants, tippers, low-beds, cranes, forklifts, concrete pumps, block machines, crushers, drill rigs, compressors, generators, pumps, dredgers, vessels, piling rigs and survey instruments.

entry.title: Price update 2026-10-01
entry.summary: v3: added 457 materials, tools and test services, 47 labour grades, 46 plant items and 170 composite rates covering oil & gas pipelines, piling, bridges, ports and reclamation, railways, power, water and sewerage, fire, HVAC, lifts, ICT and industrial buildings. Imported items now track the naira-dollar rate.
